summary: Iter35 retest of iter34 issue ('Personas Sugeridas' widget leaking Case5/Case4/Case3/MixedFeedCase/ListCase) plus new server-side filter on GET /api/feed/posts. All 37 pytest tests pass (test_editorial_composer + test_wave12_photo_fix + test_wave12_content_sources + test_iter34_feed_filter). Backend GET /api/feed/posts?limit=20 as ANON returns 0 items (all test artifacts filtered) — no Case\d+/MixedFeedCase/list-endpoint-check/mixed-feed image/📷/.test-e2e.com leakage. As ADMIN (Cookie session_token) returns 20 items INCLUDING the same test artifacts (retro-compatible — admins still see everything). SuggestedPeopleWidget client-side TEST_NAME_RE removes test authors even when admin is logged in — verified on Home '/' with admin cookie: widget returns null (0 in DOM) because all 8 authors from /api/feed/posts?limit=8 match the test-name pattern. GET /api/content-sources/mixed-feed?limit=15 returns 15 clean items, no artifacts. See-all + load-more + Latest tab all present and clean on Home.
action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup task (not blocking): the DB is dominated by test-seed posts (all authors on /api/feed/posts are Case2-5/MixedFeedCase/ListCase). Anonymous users therefore see an EMPTY /api/feed/posts feed once artifacts are filtered. The intelligent Home feed still shows content via /api/content-sources/mixed-feed (news/jobs/events/companies), so end-user impact is minimal, but consider adding a one-shot cleanup job or a pytest teardown fixture that removes posts authored by .test-e2e.com / whose author name matches TEST_NAME_RE. Once real user posts exist, the Suggested People widget will start rendering again automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'is test artifact' predicate is now duplicated in 3 places: content_sources_routes._TEST_POST_BODY_RE + email suffix check, feed_routes.list_posts inline _TEST regex + email suffix check, and SuggestedPeopleWidget.jsx TEST_NAME_RE. Recommend extracting a shared util (e.g. /app/backend/utils/test_artifact_filter.py exporting is_test_post(doc, email) and a single regex constant) — every future endpoint that surfaces user-generated data would import it and stay consistent. Currently feed_routes uses body regex `^\s*(?:case\s?\d+|mixedfeedcase|...|📷)\s*$` matching against BODY, while SuggestedPeopleWidget matches against NAME with `^(case\s?\d+|mixedfeedcase|listcase|photo bug user)$` — different fields, different case-lists (widget covers 'photo bug user' but backend doesn't; backend covers 'list-endpoint-check' body but widget doesn't). Not a bug (each layer covers its own surface), but easy to drift.

Long-term: seed/cleanup pytest fixtures so test users/posts get deleted after runs. The runtime regex filter is a bandaid — with the current DB state, ANON users effectively see an empty /api/feed/posts.
